lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thirty-two years ago, the northern border was a battlefield. The Kareth Republic and the Varn Directorate fought a war that neither side could afford to win.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eventually, both governments signed a ceasefire treaty. The guns fell silent. The borders remained unchanged. And for thirty-two years, there was peace.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But a ceasefire does not always mean an end to war. Sometimes, it only means one side is waiting.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: To the south lies the Kareth Republic. A small democracy, with its capital at Aldmere. Its army is small, poorly tested, and has never fought a war.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: To the north stands the Varn Directorate. A powerful military state, with its capital at Vorsk. For eleven years it has been ruled by its security services, under one man: Director-General Kasimir Drevan.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Varn wants control of the northern region. Kareth stands directly in its way.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: Thirty-two years. We have waited long enough.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Our forces are positioned. The northern formations are ready. Give me the order, and Kareth will fall.

lines.speaker: ostrova
lines.text: Kareth has never attacked us. There is no justification for an invasion.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: Generals, history does not reward the patient. It rewards those who understand when patience must end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For weeks, Varn had been moving troops, tanks, artillery and aircraft towards the northern border.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Officially, they were military exercises. A routine show of strength.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: I want every formation ready before sunrise. No delays. No mistakes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kareth's leaders saw the movements. They believed it was another political threat. They did not believe an attack was coming.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Project Tempest is operational. Satellites identify targets. Drones confirm their positions. Missiles receive their coordinates.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: Explain it simply.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Every weapon knows exactly where to strike. Every target is connected to the same network.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Radar stations, air defences, command centres, communication towers. Once the network is active, they will have nowhere to hide.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tempest was not simply another weapon. It was a system designed to make every weapon work together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In a matter of hours, Kareth's entire defence could be destroyed.

lines.speaker: ostrova
lines.text: You are talking about destroying an entire country's military in hours. What happens after that?

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: We secure the region. We control the border. The operation ends before Kareth understands what happened.

lines.speaker: ostrova
lines.text: And if another country intervenes? If Tempest fails?

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: Then we adapt.

lines.speaker: ostrova
lines.text: You cannot control a war once you start it.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: I am not asking you to control it, General. I am asking you to obey.

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: I found another connection. The satellite movements match the old intelligence reports.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Elias, you have been following this for two years. The investigation was closed.

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: Because someone wanted it closed.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Glass Harbour was a disaster. Harrow was reported killed. You were blamed. Venn dismissed you.

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: We lost the operation before it even began. Someone knew our movements.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You think there was a leak?

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: I don't think, Isa. I know we were betrayed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two years earlier, Crane had led an intelligence operation inside Varn. Its mission was to uncover a secret military programme.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It was called Operation Glass Harbour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The operation failed. Intelligence officer Colonel Desmond Harrow was reported killed. Crane was accused of compromising the mission, and dismissed by Deputy Director Alda Venn.

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: We were betrayed from inside.

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: Varn is preparing something. Their movements are not exercises. They are preparing to invade.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: You are no longer part of this service, Major.

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: Tempest is real. I have evidence connecting the military movements to a targeting network.

lines.speaker: venn
lines.text: You have theories. Not evidence that can justify an international crisis.

lines.speaker: crane
lines.text: When the missiles start falling, it will be too late.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Crane was getting closer to the truth. But nobody in power was willing to listen.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: The ceasefire protected us for thirty-two years. Tonight, it becomes irrelevant.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: First strike will target Kareth's radar and communication systems. Ground forces will advance immediately afterwards.

lines.speaker: ostrova
lines.text: You are making a decision that cannot be reversed.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: The decision has already been made.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: General Kade. Begin the operation at 06:14.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Understood, Director-General.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The invasion had a time. A plan. And a name. Operation Shadow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Forty kilometres from Varn's northern command line, a small Kareth outpost prepared for another ordinary morning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Private Tomas Halden was nineteen. He had never seen combat. Neither had most of the soldiers stationed there.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Still thinking about home, Halden?

lines.speaker: halden
lines.text: Just wondering when they will let us go back.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Hopefully before the food gets worse.

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: Halden. Kell. Check your equipment. Stay alert.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Sergeant, nothing has happened here in thirty-two years.

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: And I intend to keep it that way. Do your job.

lines.speaker: halden
lines.text: Sergeant, do you think they will actually attack?

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: I think you should stop worrying about things you cannot control.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Movement on the northern ridge.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: I have movement. Multiple vehicles. Can't identify the formation.

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: Are they inside the border?

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Not yet. But they're getting closer.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Probably another exercise.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Exercises don't move like that.

lines.speaker: halden
lines.text: Sergeant?

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: All stations, maintain alert. Nobody leaves their position.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: All formations are in position. Tempest is connected.

lines.speaker: ostrova
lines.text: Last chance to stop this.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: There will be no second chance.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Targeting network confirmed. All systems are ready.

lines.speaker: drevan
lines.text: Proceed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At 06:14, thirty-two years of peace came to an end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The first missiles struck before the warning sirens could finish their first cycle.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Incoming! Take cover!

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: Contact front! Enemy armour! Everyone into cover!

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Tomas! Move!

lines.speaker: halden
lines.text: What is happening?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tempest had found its targets. Radar stations, communication centres and military positions across northern Kareth were being destroyed.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Tomas! Get up! We have to move!

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: Hold this position! Do not let them through!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: More armour coming! We can't hold them!

lines.speaker: halden
lines.text: Sergeant! What do we do?

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: We fight! That's what we do!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kareth had spent thirty-two years believing the war was over. Its soldiers had never fought a battle. Its defences were falling. And the enemy was already at the gates.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For Private Tomas Halden, this was supposed to be another morning on border duty.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It became the first day of a war that would change everything.
